I was really skeptical because I usually only use percale cotton sheets / pillow cases (I run hot and need cool bedding), but these feel so good in the summer time.  They're silky and cool, I don't slide off of them like one would with satin, and they do seem to breathe.  Really nice.

title: coooool
body: as a soundtrack to this review, i recommend that you queue your fave song by coolio. it's just that kinda old school goodness. old school new school. so it's no secret that there have been fabrics developed to retain or reflect heat especially for athletic purposes. i previously reviewed a fitted sheet by this brand with the same material and was thrilled to find that, despite not being in menopause, the super smooth super cool non-heat-retaining nature of the lilac purple sheet was the perfect thing for me in intermediate new england trying-to-be-summer-but-just-persistently-muggy weather which is prone to potentially waking up sweaty; no one wants that. super cool solution! so of course after reviewing that sheet, i was very interested in getting a couple super cool pillow cases. as expected, they're the same material. they're super cool and super soft. they wash well and tolerate the dryer, like the sheet. and they're perfect for warmer or otherwise mega humid climates for comfortable sleep. this is notwithstanding the fact that in general, folks do prefer a slightly cooler temperature when dozing off, which has been adapted by various smart bed technologies; no, i do not have one and have yet to try one. low-tech in place of high tech, and no electricity needed. i'm a fan (get it? ha).
translation:
作为本次评论的配乐，我建议您将 Coolio 的您最喜欢的歌曲排队。
这就是那种老派的善良。 老学校新学校。
因此，众所周知，已经开发出可以保留或反射热量的织物，特别是用于运动目的。 我之前评论过该品牌相同材质的床笠，很高兴地发现，尽管我没有处于更年期，但丁香紫色床单的超光滑超凉非保温性质对我来说是中级的完美选择新英格兰试图成为夏天，但天气持续闷热，很容易醒来出汗； 没有人想要这样。 超酷的解决方案！
当然，在看过那张床单后，我对买几个超酷的枕套非常感兴趣。 正如预期的那样，它们是相同的材料。 它们超级酷而且超级柔软。 它们像床单一样耐洗且耐烘干。 它们非常适合温暖或潮湿的气候，提供舒适的睡眠。 尽管如此，一般来说，人们在打瞌睡时确实更喜欢稍微凉爽的温度，各种智能床技术已经适应了这一点； 不，我没有，也还没有尝试过。 用低技术代替高科技，并且不需要电力。 我是一个粉丝（明白吗？哈）。

title: This review is for the cooling pillowcase
body: These pillow cases are very, very soft and stretchy. and slippery...  When I put my head on my pillow the first time I used this pillow case I thought it felt cool, and then the 2nd night I was certain that the pillow felt cooler.  It also appears to have reduced the amount of sweating I do at night.  So for me this is a 5 star pillow case...  I use  a cervical neck support memory foam pillow.  However my wife is not such a big fan, her pillow is an overstuffed shredded memory foam pillow and she says her head is sliding  around on the pillow at night.  She did notice that her pillow felt cooler when she went to bed but the slipperiness is too much for her so for her it is 3.5 stars.  There is no question that for both of us we can notice the pillow feels cooler at night and for me has helped with sweating.  But if you use an overstuffed pillow this pillow case may not be for you?
translation:
这些枕套非常非常柔软且有弹性。 而且很滑...

当我第一次使用这个枕套时，当我把头放在枕头上时，我觉得它感觉很凉，然后第二天晚上，我确信枕头感觉很凉。 它似乎还减少了我晚上的出汗量。 所以对我来说，这是一个五星级枕套......我使用颈椎支撑记忆海绵枕头。

然而我的妻子不太喜欢，她的枕头是一个填充过多的记忆海绵碎片枕头，她说她的头晚上在枕头上滑动。 她确实注意到，当她上床睡觉时，她的枕头感觉凉爽，但太滑了，对她来说太滑了，所以对她来说，这是 3.5 颗星。

毫无疑问，对于我们俩来说，我们都可以注意到枕头在晚上感觉凉爽，对我来说有助于出汗。 但如果您使用过大的枕头，那么这款枕套可能不适合您？

body: These pillowcases feel great to the touch, smooth and a noticable cooling quality.  However, I found that my very poofy queen pillows aren't enclosed well with the envelope closure. It gaps open, partially exposing the pillow end. Admittedly these pillows are overstuffed and larger than the average queen sized pillow, so the envelope closure probably works fine for the average pillow, but if your pillows are very poofy, you might have the same issue.
translation: 这些枕套触感极佳、光滑且具有明显的清凉效果。 然而，我发现我的大号枕头没有用信封封口很好地封闭。 它张开，部分暴露枕头端。 诚然，这些枕头填充过多，并且比普通大号枕头大，因此信封封口可能适合普通枕头，但如果您的枕头非常蓬松，您可能会遇到同样的问题。

title: Cool pillow case. Literally!
body: I really like this pillow case. I don't know how they do it, but when you first lay on it it feels cold, not just cool. Of course, it settles down to a very comfortable temperature, but when you move your head to another spot, it feels cool again. For me, this is a great feature and it keeps me cool through the night. Also, it is made of a soft and smooth material which is very comfortable. The size is great for even larger pillows. I have not tried washing it yet, but if there are any issues I will update my review.
translation: 我真的很喜欢这个枕套。我不知道他们是怎么做到的，但是当你第一次躺在上面时，感觉很冷，而不仅仅是凉爽。当然，它会降到非常舒适的温度，但是当您将头移到另一个地方时，它会再次感到凉爽。对我来说，这是一个很棒的功能，它让我整夜保持凉爽。此外，它由柔软光滑的材料制成，非常舒适。尺寸非常适合更大的枕头。我还没有尝试洗它，但如果有任何问题，我会更新我的评论。
